messages:
sara_support: Heads-up — EDU partner (Cohort X) reports promo code EDU-COHORT-2026 landed in their hosted dev org instead of the Dedicated tenant we reserved. They hit a failure when trying to provision dedicated GPUs. Tenant that got the credit: acme-edu-demo-hosted (org slug). Intended target: acme-edu-dedicated-001. Promo applied 2026-03-01 by onboarding flow. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/xxxx (customer provided). Can billing/infra reassign so provisioning can continue? :eyes:

alex_billing: Sorry for the trouble. Do we have the grant record id or internal promo_id? Was the credit applied at org-level billing or to a user invoice? Also need the customer account_id and contact email to confirm auth for manual ops. :thinking:

sara_support: Grant code is EDU-COHORT-2026 (as above). Customer account_id: acct_0A1B2C3 (public). Applied to org-level billing on the hosted org (org: acme-edu-demo-hosted). Contact: emma@acme.edu. I can share logs privately if needed.

tom_customerops: I pulled the ledger entries. Quick lookup SQL I ran: 
```
SELECT id, code, amount_usd_cents, org_id, applied_at, status
FROM promo_grants
WHERE code = 'EDU-COHORT-2026';
```
Result: `id=98321, code=EDU-COHORT-2026, amount_usd_cents=1000000, org_id=310987, applied_at='2026-03-01T14:22:05Z', status='applied'` — org_id 310987 corresponds to acme-edu-demo-hosted. Intended dedicated org_id should be 112233.

ingrid_engineer: Looks like classic namespace mix: grant was attached to hosted org row. We can't re-run the onboarding promo (it will dedupe). Suggested approach: 1) create a new promo_grants row for org_id=112233 referencing same promo template (mark provenance manual_migration). 2) mark the existing hosted grant revoked (status=revoked) so customer doesn't have double-credit. 3) run the billing reapply job to push balance to dedicated tenant. Commands I recommend: 
```
-- revoke hosted grant
UPDATE promo_grants SET status='revoked', note='migrated to dedicated by ops' WHERE id=98321;
-- create new grant for dedicated
INSERT INTO promo_grants (code, amount_usd_cents, org_id, applied_at, status, note)
VALUES ('EDU-COHORT-2026', 1000000, 112233, now(), 'applied', 'manual_migration from hosted:98321');
-- trigger reapply
./bin/apply_credit --tenant acme-edu-dedicated-001 --grant-id 98321-mig
```
I know the ops tool expects a grant id; if you create a new row it will have a new id (example 98321-mig above). Put a short maintenance window note since balance events will reindex usage. :white_check_mark:

alex_billing: Agree with manual migration. Two asks before we run: (1) confirm customer approves us revoking the hosted credit (they said dedicated is the important one), (2) snapshot the hosted tenant balance so we can restore if we messed up.

sara_support: Customer (emma@acme.edu) confirmed in-thread: "please move it to our dedicated tenant — dedicated is what we'll use for the course infra." I took a hosted balance snapshot: hosted_balance_before = 1200000 cents.

deploy-bot: promo_move_job started by ingrid_engineer for grant_source_id=98321 -> target_org=112233 at 2026-03-02T09:03:12Z

ingrid_engineer: Ran the SQL steps and then triggered apply_credit with the new grant id (98457). Command output: 
```
$ ./bin/apply_credit --tenant acme-edu-dedicated-001 --grant-id 98457
INFO: validating grant 98457 -> OK
INFO: crediting tenant acme-edu-dedicated-001 amount 1000000 cents
INFO: reindexing billing events
SUCCESS: tenant balance updated +$10000.00
```
I also set the old hosted grant status='revoked' and added a note linking to migration ticket #MG-4578.

sara_support: Confirming provisioning now succeeds — dedicated cluster creation completed and K8s nodes came up for their dedicated pool. Customer verified end-to-end: "cluster is up, thanks!" :raised_hands:

alex_billing: Verified ledger: hosted_balance_after = 200000 cents (hosted retained its actual usage, migrated credit removed), dedicated_balance_after = 1000000 cents applied. Closing once we push migration audit to finance.

tom_customerops: Added audit entry: MIGRATION TG-98457, original=98321, operator=ingrid_engineer, approved_by=emma@acme.edu. Marking support ticket resolved. :white_check_mark:
